$comment: Five components, the aggregate packages ai-agent-facts, os-facts, devtool-facts, distribution-facts and service-facts, released on a release train: a release/vX.Y branch carries the whole repository, cut-release.sh --units picks the packages that board it, and scoped to the train this config holds only those. separate-pull-requests is false so the train gets a single Release PR with one changelog per package. Nothing is released from main.
